newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai T-bill repo rates end up, spots down.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai T-bill repo rates end up, spots down.

text.p: Contracts on the treasury bill repurchase market in Shanghai closed up across the board on Thursday in active trading mainly boosted by new issues on the domestic A share markets, traders said.
The annual rate for the most actively traded seven-day contract rose to 12.50 percent from 8.01 percent on Wednesday.
Total turnover of the six-contract market rose sharply to 9.8 million losts from 4.3 million lots.
One lot is 1,000 yuan face value of treasury bills.
